result.title: SplatFlow3D: Learning Scene Flow via 3D Motion Feature Splatting
result.summary: Considering the motion continuity and stability of 3D objects over short inter-frame intervals, introducing multi-frame settings in scene flow estimation can potentially address occlusion. In this paper, we propose a two-frame backbone, SimpleFlow3D, which integrates dense information from the image plane and sparse information from the depth dimension in a decoupling-followed-by-coupling manner by hierarchically constructing the 3D motion feature. SimpleFlow3D achieves SOTA results with minimal parameters. We also propose a weight-sharing multi-frame framework to splat the previous 3D motion feature to the current estimation process. The framework unifies the first and non-first frame inference by constructing pseudo inputs. After combining the proposed framework and backbone, the newly born multi-frame method SplatFlow3D further advances the state of the art. It achieves lower errors than the two-frame backbone, with fewer parameters than current methods. On both KITTI and Spring, SplatFlow3D ranked 1st over all published and submitted methods. Experiments show that SplatFlow3D improves occlusion handling, non-rigid motion estimation, and generalization to real-world scenes. Code is available at https://github.com/wwsource/SplatFlow3D.

AI.brief_summary: 论文面向 3D 场景流估计，提出两帧骨干 SimpleFlow3D（先解耦再耦合地分层构建 3D 运动特征），并用权重共享的多帧框架将前一帧的运动特征 splat 到当前估计中，形成 SplatFlow3D，在 KITTI 与 Spring 上降低误差并改善遮挡与非刚性运动处理。
AI.relevance_reason: 其做法是把跨帧抽取的几何特征 splat 并复用为当前步的估计输入，可能为 latent 推理状态在遮挡条件下如何跨步传播与更新提供可供核查的类比，但与 VLM 推理、证据筛选与停止决策无直接关联。
